318int xml_save_color_to_file (xmlTextWriterPtr writer, int did, gchar * legend, gchar * key, ColRGBA col)
319{
320 int rc;
321 gchar * str;
322 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"parameter");
323 if (rc < 0) return 0;
324 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute(writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"info", BAD_CAST legend);
325 if (rc < 0) return 0;
326 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"key", BAD_CAST key);
327 if (rc < 0) return 0;
328 if (did > -1)
329 {
330 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", did);
331 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"id", BAD_CAST str);
332 g_free (str);
333 if (rc < 0) return 0;
334 }
335 str = g_strdup_printf ("%f", col.red);
336 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"red", BAD_CAST str);
337 g_free (str);
338 if (rc < 0) return 0;
339 str = g_strdup_printf ("%f", col.green);
340 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"green", BAD_CAST str);
341 g_free (str);
342 if (rc < 0) return 0;
343 str = g_strdup_printf ("%f", col.blue);
344 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"blue", BAD_CAST str);
345 g_free (str);
346 if (rc < 0) return 0;
347 str = g_strdup_printf ("%f", col.alpha);
348 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"alpha", BAD_CAST str);
349 g_free (str);
350 if (rc < 0) return 0;
351 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
352 if (rc < 0) return 0;
353 return 1;
354}

412int xml_save_parameter_to_file (xmlTextWriterPtr writer, gchar * xml_leg, gchar * xml_key, gboolean doid, int xml_id, gchar * value)
413{
414 int rc;
415 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"parameter");
416 if (rc < 0) return 0;
417 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"info", BAD_CAST xml_leg);
418 if (rc < 0) return 0;
419 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"key", BAD_CAST xml_key);
420 if (rc < 0) return 0;
421 if (doid)
422 {
423 gchar * str;
424 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", xml_id);
425 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"id", BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)str);
426 g_free (str);
427 if (rc < 0) return 0;
428 }
429 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteFormatString (writer, "%s", value);
430 if (rc < 0) return 0;
431 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
432 if (rc < 0) return 0;
433 return 1;
434}

463 gchar * xml_delta_num_leg[NUM_DELTA] = {i18n("g(r): number of δr"), i18n("s(q): number of δq"), i18n("s(k): number of δk"), i18n("g(r) FFT: number of δr"),
464 i18n("Dij: number of δr [min(Dij)-max(Dij)]"), i18n("Angles distribution: number of δθ [0-180°]"),
465 i18n("Spherical harmonics: l(max) in [2-40]"), i18n("MSD: steps between configurations"),

477 i18n("Maximum number of rings of size n per MD step"),
478 i18n("Only search for AAAA chains"),
479 i18n("Only search for ABAB chains"),

483 i18n("Number of analyzed δt steps"),
484 i18n("Number of analyzed q points"),
485 i18n("Number of frequency points")};

523 /* Create a new XmlWriter for ATOMES_CONFIG, with no compression. */
524 writer = xmlNewTextWriterFilename (ATOMES_CONFIG, 0);
525 if (writer == NULL) return 0;
526 rc = xmlTextWriterSetIndent(writer, 1);
527 if (rc < 0) return 0;
528 /* Start the document with the xml default for the version,
529 * encoding MY_ENCODING and the default for the standalone
530 * declaration. */
531 rc = xmlTextWriterStartDocument (writer, NULL, MY_ENCODING, NULL);
532 if (rc < 0) return 0;
533
534 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteComment (writer, (const xmlChar *)_("atomes preferences XML file"));
535 if (rc < 0) return 0;
536
537 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"atomes_preferences-xml");
538 if (rc < 0) return 0;
539 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"general");
540 if (rc < 0) return 0;
541 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("File opening"), "default_instance", TRUE, 0, (default_instance) ? "single" : "multiple(s)");
542 if (! rc) return 0;
543 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
544 if (rc < 0) return 0;
545
546 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"analysis");
547 if (rc < 0) return 0;
548 int i, j, k, l, m, n, o;
549 gchar * str;
550
551 if (default_totcut > 0.0 || default_bond_cutoff)
552 {
553 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"cutoffs");
554 if (rc < 0) return 0;
555 if (default_totcut > 0.0)
556 {
557 str = g_strdup_printf ("%lf", default_totcut);
558 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("Total cutoff"), "default_totcut", TRUE, 0, str);
559 g_free (str);
560 if (! rc) return 0;
561 }
562 if (default_bond_cutoff)
563 {
564 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"partials");
565 if (rc < 0) return 0;
566 bond_cutoff * tmp_cut = default_bond_cutoff;
567 while (tmp_cut)
568 {
569 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"parameter");
570 if (rc < 0) return 0;
571 str = g_strdup_printf (_("cutoff %s-%s"), periodic_table_info[tmp_cut -> Z[0]].lab, periodic_table_info[tmp_cut -> Z[1]].lab);
572 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute(writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"info", BAD_CAST str);
573 g_free (str);
574 if (rc < 0) return 0;
575 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", tmp_cut -> Z[0]);
576 rc = xmlTextWriterWriteAttribute (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"α", BAD_CAST str);
577 g_free (str);
578 if (rc < 0) return 0;
579 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", tmp_cut -> Z[1]);

1121 str = g_strdup_printf ("%f", (default_axis.axis == WIREFRAME) ? default_axis.line : default_axis.rad);
1122 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, (default_axis.axis == WIREFRAME) ? _("Wireframe width") : _("Cylinder radius"), "default_axis", TRUE, default_axis.axis, str);
1123 g_free (str);
1124 if (! rc) return 0;
1125 str = g_strdup_printf ("%f", default_axis.length);
1126 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("Length"), "default_axis", TRUE, 2, str);
1127 g_free (str);
1128 if (! rc) return 0;
1129 if (default_axis.labels)
1130 {
1131 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"labels");
1132 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1133 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_label[2].render);
1134 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[1]), "default_label", TRUE, 1, str);
1135 g_free (str);
1136 if (! rc) return 0;
1137 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_label[2].scale);
1138 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[2]), "default_label", TRUE, 2, str);
1139 g_free (str);
1140 if (! rc) return 0;
1141 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[3]), "default_label", TRUE, 3, default_label[2].font);
1142 if (! rc) return 0;
1143 for (i=0; i<3; i++)
1144 {
1145 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_axis_leg[i]), "axis_legend", TRUE, i, default_axis.title[i]);
1146 if (! rc) return 0;
1147 }
1148 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
1149 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1150 }
1151 if (default_axis.color)
1152 {
1153 for (i=0; i<3; i++)
1154 {
1155 rc = xml_save_color_to_file (writer, i, _("Color"), "default_axis", default_axis.color[i]);
1156 if (! rc) return 0;
1157 }
1158 }
1159 // End axis
1160 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
1161 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1162 }
1163
1164 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"measures");
1165 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1166 gchar * m_key[2]={"standard", "selection"};
1167 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
1168 {
1169 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST m_key[i]);
1170 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1171 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"labels");
1172 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1173 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_label[i+3].position);
1174 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[0]), "default_label", TRUE, 0, str);
1175 g_free (str);
1176 if (! rc) return 0;
1177 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_label[i+3].render);
1178 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[1]), "default_label", TRUE, 1, str);
1179 g_free (str);
1180 if (! rc) return 0;
1181 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_label[i+3].scale);
1182 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[2]), "default_label", TRUE, 2, str);
1183 g_free (str);
1184 if (! rc) return 0;
1185 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _(xml_label_leg[3]), "default_label", TRUE, 3, default_label[i+3].font);
1186 if (! rc) return 0;
1187 xml_save_color_to_file (writer, i+3, _("Font color"), "default_font_color", default_label[i+3].color[0]);
1188 if (! rc) return 0;
1189
1190 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer); // End label
1191 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1192 // mtilt
1193 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_mtilt[i]);
1194 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("Tilt along"), "default_mtilt", TRUE, i, str);
1195 g_free (str);
1196 if (! rc) return 0;
1197 // mtilt
1198 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_mpattern[i]);
1199 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("Pattern"), "default_mpattern", TRUE, i, str);
1200 g_free (str);
1201 if (! rc) return 0;
1202 // mfactor
1203 str = g_strdup_printf ("%d", default_mfactor[i]);
1204 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("Factor"), "default_mfactor", TRUE, i, str);
1205 g_free (str);
1206 if (! rc) return 0;
1207 // mfactor
1208 str = g_strdup_printf ("%lf", default_mwidth[i]);
1209 rc = xml_save_parameter_to_file (writer, _("Width"), "default_mwidth", TRUE, i, str);
1210 g_free (str);
1211 if (! rc) return 0;
1212
1213 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer); // End measures type
1214 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1215 }
1216
1217 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer); // End measures
1218 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1219
1220 rc = xmlTextWriterStartElement (writer, BAD_CAST (const xmlChar *)"atom-selections");
1221 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1222 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
1223 {
1224 xml_save_color_to_file (writer, i, _("Selection color"), "default_sel_color", default_sel_color[i]);
1225 if (! rc) return 0;
1226 }
1227 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
1228 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1229
1230 // End view
1231 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
1232 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1233
1234 rc = xmlTextWriterEndElement (writer);
1235 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1236
1237 rc = xmlTextWriterEndDocument (writer);
1238 if (rc < 0) return 0;
1239
1240 xmlFreeTextWriter (writer);
1241 return 1;
1242}

1701void read_parameter (xmlNodePtr parameter_node)
1702{
1703 xmlNodePtr p_node;
1704 xmlAttrPtr p_details;
1705 gboolean set_codevar, set_id;
1706 gboolean set_x, set_y, set_z;
1707 gboolean set_r, set_g, set_b, set_a;
1708 gboolean set_alpha, set_beta;
1709 ColRGBA col;
1710 gchar * key = NULL;
1711 xmlChar * content, * p_cont;
1712 int id;
1713 dint bond;
1714 float start, end;
1715 vec3_t vec;
1716 while (parameter_node)
1717 {
1718 content = xmlNodeGetContent(parameter_node);
1719 p_details = parameter_node -> properties;
1720 set_codevar = set_id = FALSE;
1721 set_x = set_y = set_z = FALSE;
1722 set_r = set_g = set_b = set_a = FALSE;
1723 set_alpha = set_beta = FALSE;
1724 start = end = -1.0;
1725 id = -1;
1726 while (p_details)
1727 {
1728 p_node = p_details -> children;
1729 if (p_node)
1730 {
1731 p_cont = xmlNodeGetContent(p_node);
1732 if (g_strcmp0("key",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1733 {
1734 key = g_strdup_printf ("%s", p_cont);
1735 set_codevar = TRUE;
1736 }
1737 else if (g_strcmp0("id",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1738 {
1739 id = (int) string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1740 set_id = TRUE;
1741 }
1742 else if (g_strcmp0("α",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1743 {
1744 bond.a = (int) string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1745 set_alpha = TRUE;
1746 }
1747 else if (g_strcmp0("β",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1748 {
1749 bond.b = (int) string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1750 set_beta = TRUE;
1751 }
1752 else if (g_strcmp0("x",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1753 {
1754 vec.x = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1755 set_x = TRUE;
1756 }
1757 else if (g_strcmp0("y",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1758 {
1759 vec.y = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1760 set_y = TRUE;
1761 }
1762 else if (g_strcmp0("z",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1763 {
1764 vec.z = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1765 set_z = TRUE;
1766 }
1767 else if (g_strcmp0("start",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1768 {
1769 start = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1770 }
1771 else if (g_strcmp0("end",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1772 {
1773 end = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1774 }
1775 else if (g_strcmp0("red",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1776 {
1777 col.red = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1778 set_r = TRUE;
1779 }
1780 else if (g_strcmp0("green",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1781 {
1782 col.green = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1783 set_g = TRUE;
1784 }
1785 else if (g_strcmp0("blue",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1786 {
1787 col.blue = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1788 set_b = TRUE;
1789 }
1790 else if (g_strcmp0("alpha",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1791 {
1792 col.alpha = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1793 set_a = TRUE;
1794 }
1795 xmlFree (p_cont);
1796 }
1797 p_details = p_details -> next;
1798 }
1799
1800 if ((set_codevar && (set_id || (set_r && set_g && set_b && set_a))) || (set_alpha && set_beta))
1801 {
1802 // g_print ("key= %s, id= %d, content= %s\n", key, id, content);
1803 set_parameter (content, key, id, (set_alpha && set_beta) ? & bond : NULL, (set_x && set_y && set_z) ? & vec : NULL, start, end, (set_r && set_g && set_b && set_a) ? & col : NULL);
1804 }
1805 if (key) g_free (key);
1806 xmlFree (content);
1807 parameter_node = parameter_node -> next;
1808 parameter_node = findnode (parameter_node, "parameter");
1809 }
1810}
1811
1819void read_light (xmlNodePtr light_node)
1820{
1821 xmlNodePtr l_node, p_node;
1822 xmlNodePtr parameter_node;
1823 xmlAttrPtr l_details, p_details;
1824 gchar * key = NULL;
1825 int lid;
1826 gboolean set_codevar;
1827 gboolean set_lid = FALSE;
1828 gboolean set_x, set_y, set_z;
1829 xmlChar * content, * p_cont;
1830 vec3_t vec;
1831 l_details = light_node -> properties;
1832 while (l_details)
1833 {
1834 l_node = l_details -> children;
1835 if (l_node)
1836 {
1837 if (g_strcmp0("id",(char *)l_details -> name) == 0)
1838 {
1839 content = xmlNodeGetContent(l_node);
1840 lid = (int) string_to_double ((gpointer)content);
1841 xmlFree (content);
1842 set_lid = TRUE;
1843 }
1844 }
1845 l_details = l_details -> next;
1846 }
1847 if (set_lid)
1848 {
1849 parameter_node = findnode (light_node -> children, "parameter");
1850 set_codevar = FALSE;
1851 set_x = set_y = set_z = FALSE;
1852 while (parameter_node)
1853 {
1854 content = xmlNodeGetContent(parameter_node);
1855 p_details = parameter_node -> properties;
1856 while (p_details)
1857 {
1858 p_node = p_details -> children;
1859 if (p_node)
1860 {
1861 p_cont = xmlNodeGetContent(p_node);
1862 if (g_strcmp0("key",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1863 {
1864 key = g_strdup_printf ("%s", p_cont);
1865 set_codevar = TRUE;
1866 }
1867 else if (g_strcmp0("x",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1868 {
1869 vec.x = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1870 set_x = TRUE;
1871 }
1872 else if (g_strcmp0("y",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1873 {
1874 vec.y = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1875 set_y = TRUE;
1876 }
1877 else if (g_strcmp0("z",(char *)p_details -> name) == 0)
1878 {
1879 vec.z = string_to_double ((gpointer)p_cont);
1880 set_z = TRUE;
1881 }
1882 xmlFree (p_cont);
1883 }
1884 p_details = p_details -> next;
1885 }
1886 if (set_codevar)
1887 {
1888 set_parameter (content, key, lid, NULL, (set_x && set_y && set_z) ? & vec : NULL, -1.0, -1.0, NULL);
1889 }
1890 if (key) g_free (key);
1891 xmlFree (content);
1892 parameter_node = parameter_node -> next;
1893 parameter_node = findnode (parameter_node, "parameter");
1894 }
1895 }
1896}

1920void read_style_from_xml_file (xmlNodePtr style_node, int style)
1921{
1922 xmlNodePtr node;
1923 gchar * str;
1924 int i, j, k, l;
1925 i = (style == 0 || style == 2) ? 0 : (style == 1 || style == 4) ? 1 : 2;
1926 for (j=0; j<2; j++)
1927 {
1928 k = (style == 2) ? 4 : 1;
1929 for (l=0; l<k; l++)
1930 {
1931 str = (j) ? g_strdup_printf ("clone-%s", (k == 4) ? xml_filled_leg[l] : xml_atom_leg[i]) : g_strdup_printf ("%s", (k == 4) ? xml_filled_leg[l] : xml_atom_leg[i]);
1932 node = findnode (style_node, str);
1933 if (node)
1934 {
1935 if (j)
1936 {
1937 radius_id = (l) ? 12 + l : style + 5;
1938 }
1939 else
1940 {
1941 radius_id = (l) ? 9 + l : style;
1942 }
1943 read_preferences (node);
1944 }
1945 }
1946 }
1947 i = (style < 2) ? style : 2;
1948 for (j=0; j<2; j++)
1949 {
1950 str = (j) ? g_strdup_printf ("clone-%s", xml_bond_leg[i]) : g_strdup_printf ("%s", xml_bond_leg[i]);
1951 node = findnode (style_node, str);
1952 radius_id = (j) ? style + 3 : style;
1953 if (node) read_preferences(node);
1954 }
1955}

1962void read_preferences_from_xml_file ()
1963{
1964 xmlDoc * doc;
1965 xmlTextReaderPtr reader;
1966 xmlNodePtr racine;
1967 xmlNodePtr node, p_node, l_node, c_node;
1968 int i;
1969 reader = xmlReaderForFile (ATOMES_CONFIG, NULL, 0);
1970 if (reader)
1971 {
1972 doc = xmlParseFile (ATOMES_CONFIG);
1973 if (doc)
1974 {
1975 racine = xmlDocGetRootElement (doc);
1976 if (racine)
1977 {
1978 if (g_strcmp0 ((char *)(racine -> name), "atomes_preferences-xml") == 0)
1979 {
1980 node = findnode(racine -> children, "general");
1981 if (node)
1982 {
1983 read_preferences (node);
1984 }
1985 node = findnode(racine -> children, "analysis");
1986 if (node)
1987 {
1988 p_node = findnode (node -> children, "cutoffs");
1989 if (p_node)
1990 {
1991 read_preferences (p_node);
1992 l_node = findnode(p_node -> children, "partials");
1993 if (l_node)
1994 {
1995 read_preferences (l_node);
1996 }
1997 }
1998 read_preferences (node);
1999 }
2000 node = findnode(racine -> children, "opengl");
2001 if (node)
2002 {
2003 p_node = findnode (node -> children, "material");
2004 if (p_node)
2005 {
2006 read_preferences (p_node);
2007 }
2008 p_node = findnode (node -> children, "lightning");
2009 if (p_node)
2010 {
2011 read_preferences (p_node);
2012 l_node = findnode (p_node -> children, "light");
2013 while (l_node)
2014 {
2015 read_light (l_node);
2016 l_node = l_node -> next;
2017 l_node = findnode (l_node, "light");
2018 }
2019 }
2020 p_node = findnode (node -> children, "fog");
2021 if (p_node)
2022 {
2023 read_preferences(p_node);
2024 }
2025 read_preferences (node);
2026 }
2027 node = findnode(racine -> children, "model");
2028 if (node)
2029 {
2030 read_preferences (node);
2031 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "atoms_and_bonds");
2032 if (p_node)
2033 {
2034 for (i=0; i<OGL_STYLES; i++)
2035 {
2036 l_node = findnode (p_node -> children, xml_style_leg[i]);
2037 if (l_node)
2038 {
2039 read_style_from_xml_file (l_node -> children, i);
2040 }
2041 }
2042 }
2043 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "labels");
2044 if (p_node)
2045 {
2046 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
2047 {
2048 l_node = findnode (p_node -> children, (i) ? "clones" : "atoms");
2049 if (l_node)
2050 {
2051 label_id = i;
2052 read_preferences (l_node);
2053 c_node = findnode(l_node -> children, "colors");
2054 if (c_node)
2055 {
2056 read_preferences (c_node);
2057 }
2058 }
2059 }
2060 }
2061 c_node = findnode(node -> children, "colors");
2062 if (c_node)
2063 {
2064 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
2065 {
2066 l_node = findnode (c_node -> children, (i) ? "clones" : "atoms");
2067 if (l_node)
2068 {
2069 label_id = i;
2070 read_preferences (l_node);
2071 }
2072 }
2073 }
2074 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "box");
2075 if (p_node)
2076 {
2077 read_preferences (p_node);
2078 }
2079 }
2080 node = findnode(racine -> children, "view");
2081 if (node)
2082 {
2083 read_preferences (node);
2084 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "background");
2085 if (p_node)
2086 {
2087 read_preferences (p_node);
2088 }
2089 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "representation");
2090 if (p_node)
2091 {
2092 read_preferences (p_node);
2093 }
2094 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "axis");
2095 if (p_node)
2096 {
2097 read_preferences (p_node);
2098 l_node = findnode(p_node -> children, "labels");
2099 if (l_node)
2100 {
2101 label_id = 2;
2102 default_axis.labels = TRUE;
2103 read_preferences (l_node);
2104 }
2105 c_node = findnode(p_node -> children, "colors");
2106 if (c_node)
2107 {
2108 read_preferences (c_node);
2109 }
2110 }
2111 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "measures");
2112 if (p_node)
2113 {
2114 l_node = findnode(p_node -> children, "standard");
2115 if (l_node)
2116 {
2117 c_node = findnode(l_node -> children, "labels");
2118 if (c_node)
2119 {
2120 label_id = 3;
2121 read_preferences (c_node);
2122 }
2123 read_preferences (l_node);
2124 }
2125 l_node = findnode(p_node -> children, "selection");
2126 if (l_node)
2127 {
2128 c_node = findnode(l_node -> children, "labels");
2129 if (c_node)
2130 {
2131 label_id = 4;
2132 read_preferences (c_node);
2133 }
2134 read_preferences (l_node);
2135 }
2136 }
2137 p_node = findnode(node -> children, "atom-selections");
2138 if (p_node)
2139 {
2140 read_preferences (p_node);
2141 }
2142 }
2143 }
2144 }
2145 xmlFreeDoc(doc);
2146 }
2147 xmlFreeTextReader(reader);
2148 }
2149 xmlCleanupParser();
2150}

2405GtkWidget * pref_list (gchar * mess[2], int nelem, gchar * mlist[nelem][2], gchar * end)
2406{
2407 gchar * str;
2408 GtkWidget * vbox = create_vbox (BSEP);
2409 GtkWidget * vvbox = create_vbox (BSEP);
2410 GtkWidget * hbox;
2411 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vvbox, markup_label(_(mess[0]), -1, -1, 0.5, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 5);
2412 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vvbox, markup_label(_(mess[1]), -1, -1, 0.5, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
2413 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vbox, vvbox, FALSE, FALSE, 20);
2414 int i;
2415 for (i=0; i<nelem; i++)
2416 {
2417 hbox = create_hbox (BSEP);
2418 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, markup_label(" ", 60, -1, 0.0, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
2419 str = g_strdup_printf ("<b>%s</b>", _(mlist[i][0]));
2420 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, markup_label(str, 120, -1, 0.0, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 5);
2421 g_free (str);
2422 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, markup_label(":", -1, -1, 1.0, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
2423 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, markup_label(_(mlist[i][1]), -1, -1, 0.0, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 10);
2424 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vbox, hbox, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
2425 }
2426 if (end)
2427 {
2428 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vbox, markup_label(_(end), -1, -1, 0.5, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 20);
2429 }
2430 return vbox;
2431}

2662element_radius * duplicate_element_radius (element_radius * old_list)
2663{
2664 if (! old_list) return NULL;
2665 element_radius * new_list = g_malloc0(sizeof*new_list);
2666 element_radius * tmp_rad, * tmp_rbd;
2667 tmp_rad = old_list;
2668 tmp_rbd = new_list;
2669 while (tmp_rad)
2670 {
2671 tmp_rbd -> Z = tmp_rad -> Z;
2672 tmp_rbd -> rad = tmp_rad -> rad;
2673 if (tmp_rad -> next)
2674 {
2675 tmp_rbd -> next = g_malloc0(sizeof*tmp_rbd -> next);
2676 tmp_rbd -> next -> prev = tmp_rbd;
2677 tmp_rbd = tmp_rbd -> next;
2678 }
2679 tmp_rad = tmp_rad -> next;
2680 }
2681 return new_list;
2682}

2694float get_radius (int object, int col, int z, element_radius * rad_list)
2695{
2696 element_radius * tmp_rad = rad_list;
2697 int ft;
2698 while (tmp_rad)
2699 {
2700 if (tmp_rad -> Z == z)
2701 {
2702 user_defined = TRUE;
2703 return tmp_rad -> rad;
2704 }
2705 tmp_rad = tmp_rad -> next;
2706 }
2707 if (object < 0)
2708 {
2709 object = - object - 2;
2710 // Bonds
2711 if (object == 0 || object == 3)
2712 {
2713 if (z < 119)
2714 {
2715 ft = 0;
2716 return set_radius_ (& z, & ft) / 4.0;
2717 }
2718 }
2719 else
2720 {
2721 return DEFAULT_SIZE;
2722 }
2723 }
2724 else
2725 {
2726 object -= 2;
2727 if (object == 2 || object == 7 || col)
2728 {
2729 ft = col;
2730 if (z < 119)
2731 {
2732 return set_radius_ (& z, & ft);
2733 }
2734 }
2735 else if (object == 1 || object == 4 || object == 6 || object == 9)
2736 {
2737 // Dots
2738 return DEFAULT_SIZE;
2739 }
2740 else if (object == 0 || object == 3 || object == 5 || object == 8)
2741 {
2742 ft = 0;
2743 return set_radius_ (& z, & ft) / 2.0;
2744 }
2745 }
2746 return 0.0;
2747}

2811G_MODULE_EXPORT void edit_pref (GtkCellRendererText * cell, gchar * path_string, gchar * new_text, gpointer user_data)
2812{
2813 int col = GPOINTER_TO_INT(user_data);
2814 GtkTreeModel * pref_model = gtk_tree_view_get_model(GTK_TREE_VIEW(pref_tree));
2815 GtkTreeIter row;
2816 gtk_tree_model_get_iter_from_string (pref_model, & row, path_string);
2817 int z;
2818 float val = string_to_double ((gpointer)new_text);
2819 gtk_tree_model_get (pref_model, & row, 3, & z, -1);
2820 gtk_list_store_set (GTK_LIST_STORE(pref_model), & row, col+4, val, -1);
2821 gboolean add_elem = FALSE;
2822 gboolean remove_elem = FALSE;
2823 element_radius * tmp_list;
2824 int col_val[4] = {1, 3, 5, 10};
2825 float v = get_radius (the_object, col, z, NULL);
2826 if (edit_list[col])
2827 {
2828 tmp_list = edit_list[col];
2829 add_elem = TRUE;
2830 while (tmp_list)
2831 {
2832 if (tmp_list -> Z == z)
2833 {
2834 tmp_list -> rad = val;
2835 if (val == v)
2836 {
2837 remove_elem = TRUE;
2838 if (tmp_list -> next)
2839 {
2840 if (tmp_list -> prev)
2841 {
2842 tmp_list -> prev -> next = tmp_list -> next;
2843 tmp_list -> next -> prev = tmp_list -> prev;
2844 }
2845 else
2846 {
2847 edit_list[col] = tmp_list -> next;
2848 edit_list[col] -> prev = NULL;
2849 }
2850 }
2851 else if (tmp_list -> prev)
2852 {
2853 edit_list[col] -> rad = tmp_list -> rad;
2854 edit_list[col] -> Z = tmp_list -> Z;
2855 edit_list[col] -> prev = NULL;
2856 }
2857 else
2858 {
2859 g_free (edit_list[col]);
2860 edit_list[col] = NULL;
2861 }
2862 add_elem = FALSE;
2863 }
2864 else
2865 {
2866 add_elem = FALSE;
2867 }
2868 }
2869 tmp_list = tmp_list -> next;
2870 }
2871 }
2872 else if (val != v)
2873 {
2874 add_elem = TRUE;
2875 }
2876
2877 if (add_elem)
2878 {
2879 if (edit_list[col])
2880 {
2881 tmp_list = edit_list[col];
2882 while (tmp_list)
2883 {
2884 if (! tmp_list -> next) break;
2885 tmp_list = tmp_list -> next;
2886 }
2887 tmp_list -> next = g_malloc0(sizeof*tmp_list -> next);
2888 tmp_list -> next -> prev = tmp_list;
2889 tmp_list = tmp_list -> next;
2890 }
2891 else
2892 {
2893 edit_list[col] = g_malloc0(sizeof*edit_list[col]);
2894 tmp_list = edit_list[col];
2895 }
2896 tmp_list -> Z = z;
2897 tmp_list -> rad = val;
2898 gtk_tree_model_get (pref_model, & row, 0, & z, -1);
2899 if (! z)
2900 {
2901 z = col_val[col];
2902 }
2903 else
2904 {
2905 int a, b, c, d;
2906 a = z / 10;
2907 b = (z - a * 10) / 5;
2908 c = (z - a * 10 - b * 5) / 3;
2909 d = z - a * 10 - b * 5 - c * 3;
2910 z = 0;
2911 if (a || col == 3) z += 10;
2912 if (b || col == 2) z += 5;
2913 if (c || col == 1) z += 3;
2914 if (d || col == 0) z += 1;
2915 }
2916 gtk_list_store_set (GTK_LIST_STORE(pref_model), & row, 0, z, -1);
2917 }
2918 else if (remove_elem)
2919 {
2920 gtk_tree_model_get (pref_model, & row, 0, & z, -1);
2921 z -= col_val[col];
2922 gtk_list_store_set (GTK_LIST_STORE(pref_model), & row, 0, z, -1);
2923 }
2924}

2935G_MODULE_EXPORT void edit_chem_preferences (GtkDialog * edit_chem, gint response_id, gpointer data)
2936{
2937 int i, j, k, l;
2938 int object = GPOINTER_TO_INT (data);
2939 gboolean do_style = (object < 100) ? TRUE : FALSE;
2940 gboolean do_label = (object == 1000 || object == 1001) ? TRUE : FALSE;
2941 switch (response_id)
2942 {
2943 case GTK_RESPONSE_APPLY:
2944 if (do_style)
2945 {
2946 if (object < 0)
2947 {
2948 object = - object - 2;
2949 if (tmp_bond_rad[object]) g_free (tmp_bond_rad[object]);
2950 tmp_bond_rad[object] = duplicate_element_radius (edit_list[0]);
2951 }
2952 else
2953 {
2954 j = (object == 4 || object == 9) ? 4 : 1;
2955 k = (object < 5) ? 7 : 5;
2956 object = object - 2;
2957 for (i=0; i<j; i++)
2958 {
2959 l = (i) ? 1 : 0;
2960 if (tmp_atomic_rad[object+l*k+i]) g_free (tmp_atomic_rad[object+l*k+i]);
2961 tmp_atomic_rad[object+l*k+i] = duplicate_element_radius (edit_list[i]);
2962 }
2963 }
2964 }
2965 else if (do_label)
2966 {
2967 object -= 1000;
2968 if (tmp_label_color[object]) g_free (tmp_label_color[object]);
2969 tmp_label_color[object] = duplicate_element_color (color_list);
2970 if (tmp_color)
2971 {
2972 if (! tmp_label[object] -> color) tmp_label[object] -> color = g_malloc0(sizeof*tmp_label[object] -> color);
2973 tmp_label[object] -> color[0] = * tmp_color;
2974 tmp_label[object] -> n_colors = 1;
2975 }
2976 }
2977 else
2978 {
2979 object -= 100;
2980 if (tmp_atom_color[object]) g_free (tmp_atom_color[object]);
2981 tmp_atom_color[object] = duplicate_element_color (color_list);
2982 }
2983 break;
2984 default:
2985 if (do_style)
2986 {
2987 j = (object < 0) ? 1 : (object == 4 || object == 9) ? 4 : 1;
2988 for (i=0; i<j; i++)
2989 {
2990 if (edit_list[i])
2991 {
2992 g_free (edit_list[i]);
2993 edit_list[i] = NULL;
2994 }
2995 }
2996 g_free (edit_list);
2997 edit_list = NULL;
2998 }
2999 else
3000 {
3001 g_free (color_list);
3002 color_list = NULL;
3003 }
3004 break;
3005 }
3006 if (tmp_color) g_free (tmp_color);
3007 tmp_color = NULL;
3008 destroy_this_dialog (edit_chem);
3009}

3125G_MODULE_EXPORT void run_ac_color (GtkDialog * win, gint response_id, gpointer data)

3128 {
3129 ColRGBA colo = get_window_color (GTK_WIDGET(win));
3130 int i = GPOINTER_TO_INT (data);

3132 gboolean add_elem;

3134 if (color_list)
3135 {
3136 tmp_list = color_list;
3137 add_elem = TRUE;
3138 while (tmp_list)
3139 {
3140 if (tmp_list -> Z == i)
3141 {
3142 tmp_list -> col = colo;
3143 if (are_identical_colors(colo, orig))
3144 {
3145 if (tmp_list -> next)
3146 {
3147 if (tmp_list -> prev)
3148 {
3149 tmp_list -> prev -> next = tmp_list -> next;
3150 tmp_list -> next -> prev = tmp_list -> prev;
3151 }
3152 else
3153 {
3154 color_list = tmp_list -> next;
3155 color_list -> prev = NULL;
3156 }
3157 }
3158 else if (tmp_list -> prev)
3159 {
3160 color_list -> col = tmp_list -> col;
3161 color_list -> Z = tmp_list -> Z;
3162 color_list -> prev = NULL;
3163 }
3164 else
3165 {
3166 g_free (color_list);
3167 color_list = NULL;
3168 }
3169 add_elem = FALSE;
3170 }
3171 else
3172 {
3173 add_elem = FALSE;
3174 }
3175 }
3176 tmp_list = tmp_list -> next;
3177 }
3178 }
3179 else if (! are_identical_colors(colo, orig))
3180 {
3181 add_elem = TRUE;
3182 }
3183 if (add_elem)
3184 {
3185 if (color_list)
3186 {
3187 tmp_list = color_list;
3188 while (tmp_list)
3189 {
3190 if (! tmp_list -> next) break;
3191 tmp_list = tmp_list -> next;
3192 }
3193 tmp_list -> next = g_malloc0(sizeof*tmp_list -> next);
3194 tmp_list -> next -> prev = tmp_list;
3195 tmp_list = tmp_list -> next;
3196 }
3197 else
3198 {
3199 color_list = g_malloc0(sizeof*color_list);
3200 tmp_list = color_list;
3201 }

3203 tmp_list -> col = colo;
3204 }

3407
3408 for (i=1; i<119; i++)
3409 {
3410 user_defined = FALSE;
3411 gtk_list_store_append (pref_model, & elem);

3413 {
3414 gtk_list_store_set (pref_model, & elem, 0, user_defined,

3484 pref_select = gtk_tree_view_get_selection (GTK_TREE_VIEW(pref_tree));

3492 NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);
3493#endif
3494
3495 edit_scrol = create_scroll (vbox, -1, 570, GTK_SHADOW_ETCHED_IN);

3552GtkWidget * over_param (int object, int style)
3553{

3555 GtkWidget * hbox = create_hbox (BSEP);

3562 hbox = create_hbox (BSEP);

3566 hbox = create_hbox (BSEP);

3568 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, check_button (_("Override species based parameters"), -1, -1, (object) ? tmp_o_bd_rw[style] : tmp_o_at_rs[style], G_CALLBACK(toggled_default_stuff), GINT_TO_POINTER(mod*(style+2))), FALSE, FALSE, 10);
3569 }
3570 else

3572 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, markup_label(" ", 60+clone, -1, 0.0, 0.0), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
3573 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, hbox, markup_label(_("Set default value"), -1, -1, 0.0, 0.5), FALSE, FALSE, 10);

3578 update_entry_double (GTK_ENTRY(bond_entry_over[style]), tmp_bd_rw[style]);

3604GtkWidget * style_tab (int style)
3605{
3606 GtkWidget * vbox = create_vbox (BSEP);
3607 gchar * object[3]={i18n("<b>Atom(s)</b>"), i18n("<b>Bond(s)</b>"), i18n("\t<u>Clone(s)</u>")};
3608 gchar * dim[3]={i18n("Radius"), i18n("Size"), i18n("Width")};
3609 int i;
3610 int bsid;
3611 int lid;
3612 gchar * str;
3613 gboolean do_atoms = FALSE;
3614 gboolean do_bonds = FALSE;
3615 if (style == 0 || style == 1 || style == 2 || style == 3 || style == 5)
3616 {
3617 do_atoms = TRUE;
3618 }
3619 if (style == 0 || style == 1 || style == 4)
3620 {
3621 do_bonds = TRUE;
3622 bsid = (style == 4) ? 2 : style;
3623 }
3624 if (do_atoms)
3625 {
3626 lid = (style == 3) ? 2 : (style == 1 || style == 5) ? 1 : 0;
3627 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
3628 {
3629 adv_box (vbox, object[i*2], 10-5*i, 120, 0.0);
3630 str = g_strdup_printf ("\t%s", _(dim[(lid != 1) ? 0 : 1]));
3631 adv_box (vbox, str, 10, 120, 0.0);
3632 g_free (str);
3633 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vbox, over_param (0, (style < 5) ? style+5*i : 4 + 5*i), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
3634 }
3635 }
3636 if (do_bonds)
3637 {
3638 // Bond(s) parameters
3639 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
3640 {
3641 adv_box (vbox, object[i+1], 10-5*i, 120, 0.0);
3642 str = g_strdup_printf ("\t%s", _(dim[(bsid != 1) ? 0 : 2]));
3643 adv_box (vbox, str, 10, 120, 0.0);
3644 g_free (str);
3645 add_box_child_start (GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, vbox, over_param (1, bsid+3*i), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
3646 }
3647 }
3648
3649 return vbox;
3650}

3894G_MODULE_EXPORT void set_default_num_delta (GtkEntry * res, gpointer data)
3895{
3896 int i = GPOINTER_TO_INT(data);
3897 const gchar * m = entry_get_text (res);
3898 double value = string_to_double ((gpointer)m);
3899 if (i == -1)
3900 {
3901 if (value > 0.0)
3902 {
3903 tmp_totcut = value;
3904 }
3905 update_entry_double (res, tmp_totcut);
3906 }
3907 else if (i < 9)
3908 {
3909 if (value > 0) tmp_num_delta[i] = (int) value;
3910 update_entry_int (res, tmp_num_delta[i]);
3911 if (i == 7 || i == 8)
3912 {
3913 update_entry_int (GTK_ENTRY(dyna_entry[(i == 7) ? 1 : 0][0]), tmp_num_delta[i]);
3914 update_omega_max ();
3915 }
3916 }
3917 else // delta_t
3918 {
3919 if (value > 0.0) tmp_delta_t[0] = value;
3920 update_entry_double (res, tmp_delta_t[0]);
3921 update_entry_double (GTK_ENTRY(dyna_entry[(i == 9) ? 1 : 0][1]), tmp_delta_t[0]);
3922 update_omega_max ();
3923 }
3924}

4072gboolean not_in_cutoffs (int z_a, int z_b)
4073{
4074 bond_cutoff * tmp_cut = cut_list;
4075 while (tmp_cut)
4076 {
4077 if (tmp_cut -> Z[0] == z_a && tmp_cut -> Z[1] == z_b) return FALSE;
4078 tmp_cut = tmp_cut -> next;
4079 }
4080 return TRUE;
4081}

4091G_MODULE_EXPORT void cut_spec_changed (GtkComboBox * box, gpointer data)
4092{
4093 int i, j, k, l;
4094 i = combo_get_active (cut_combo[0]);
4095 j = combo_get_active (cut_combo[1]);
4096 k = min (i+1, j+1);
4097 l = max (i+1, j+1);
4098 if (k && l)
4099 {
4100 if (not_in_cutoffs(k, l))
4101 {
4102 bond_cutoff * tmp_cut;
4103 if (! cut_list)
4104 {
4105 cut_list = g_malloc0(sizeof*cut_list);
4106 tmp_cut = cut_list;
4107 }
4108 else
4109 {
4110 tmp_cut = cut_list;
4111 while (tmp_cut -> next)
4112 {
4113 tmp_cut = tmp_cut -> next;
4114 }
4115 tmp_cut -> next = g_malloc0(sizeof*tmp_cut -> next);
4116 tmp_cut -> next -> prev = tmp_cut;
4117 tmp_cut = tmp_cut -> next;
4118 }
4119 tmp_cut -> Z[0] = min(k, l);
4120 tmp_cut -> Z[1] = max(k, l);
4121 tmp_cut -> use = FALSE;
4122 tmp_cut -> cutoff = 1.0;
4123 add_cut_box ();
4124 }
4125 }
4126}
4127
4135bond_cutoff * duplicate_cutoffs (bond_cutoff * old_cutoff)
4136{
4137 bond_cutoff * new_cutoff = NULL;
4138 bond_cutoff * cut_a, * cut_b;
4139 cut_a = old_cutoff;
4140 while (cut_a)
4141 {
4142 if (cut_a -> use)
4143 {
4144 if (! new_cutoff)
4145 {
4146 new_cutoff = g_malloc0(sizeof*new_cutoff);
4147 cut_b = new_cutoff;
4148 }
4149 else
4150 {
4151 cut_b -> next = g_malloc0(sizeof*cut_b -> next);
4152 cut_b -> next -> prev = cut_b;
4153 cut_b = cut_b -> next;
4154 }
4155 cut_b -> Z[0] = cut_a -> Z[0];
4156 cut_b -> Z[1] = cut_a -> Z[1];
4157 cut_b -> use = cut_a -> use;
4158 cut_b -> cutoff = cut_a -> cutoff;
4159 }
4160 cut_a = cut_a -> next;
4161 }
4162 return new_cutoff;
4163}

4657gboolean * up_project;
4658
4668G_MODULE_EXPORT void update_projects (GtkDialog * proj_sel, gint response_id, gpointer data)
4669{
4670 int i, j, k, l;
4671 float * tmpcut;
4672 gboolean update_bonds;
4673 switch (response_id)
4674 {
4675 case GTK_RESPONSE_OK:
4676 // To write apply to opened projects
4677 for (i=0; i<nprojects; i++)
4678 {
4679 if (up_project[i])
4680 {
4681 project * this_proj = get_project_by_id(i);
4682 if (up_project[i+nprojects])
4683 {
4684 update_bonds = FALSE;
4685 l = this_proj -> nspec * this_proj -> nspec;
4686 tmpcut = allocfloat(l);
4687 l = 0;
4688 for (j=0; j<this_proj -> nspec; j++)
4689 {
4690 for (k=0; k<this_proj -> nspec; k++, l++)
4691 {
4692 tmpcut[l] = this_proj -> chemistry -> cutoffs[j][k];
4693 }
4694 }
4695 if (this_proj -> chemistry -> grtotcutoff != default_totcut) update_bonds = TRUE;
4696 }
4697 apply_default_parameters_to_project (this_proj, up_project[i+nprojects]);
4698 if (up_project[i+nprojects])
4699 {
4700 if (! update_bonds)
4701 {
4702 l = 0;
4703 for (j=0; j<this_proj -> nspec; j++)
4704 {
4705 for (k=0; k<this_proj -> nspec; k++, l++)
4706 {
4707 if (this_proj -> chemistry -> cutoffs[j][k] != tmpcut[l]) update_bonds = TRUE;
4708 }
4709 }
4710 }
4711 if (update_bonds)
4712 {
4713 if (this_proj -> modelgl -> rings)
4714 {
4715 this_proj -> modelgl -> rings = FALSE;
4716 for (j=0; j<5; j++)
4717 {
4718 clean_rings_data (j, this_proj -> modelgl);
4719#ifdef GTK3
4720 update_rings_menus (this_proj -> modelgl);
4721#endif
4722 }
4723 }
4724 if (this_proj -> modelgl -> chains)
4725 {
4726 clean_chains_data (this_proj -> modelgl);
4727#ifdef GTK3
4728 update_chains_menus (this_proj -> modelgl);
4729#endif
4730 }
4731 bonds_update = 1;
4732 frag_update = (this_proj -> natomes > ATOM_LIMIT) ? 0 : 1;
4733 mol_update = (frag_update) ? ((this_proj -> steps > STEP_LIMIT) ? 0 : 1) : 0;
4734 this_proj -> runc[0] = FALSE;
4735 this_proj -> dmtx = FALSE;
4736 if (this_proj -> id != activep)
4737 {
4738 k = activep;
4739 active_project_changed (this_proj -> id);
4740 on_calc_bonds_released (NULL, NULL);
4741 active_project_changed (k);
4742 }
4743 else
4744 {
4745 update_project ();
4746 on_calc_bonds_released (NULL, NULL);
4747 }
4748 }
4749 }
4750 }
4751 }
4752 break;
4753 default:
4754 break;
4755 }
4756 g_free (up_project);
4757 up_project = NULL;
4758 destroy_this_dialog (proj_sel);
4759}

5175G_MODULE_EXPORT void set_default_options (GtkButton * but, gpointer data)
5176{
5177 tint * oid = (tint *)data;
5178 gchar * pstring[5]={i18n("rendering"), i18n("box"), i18n("axis"), i18n("background"), i18n("representation")};
5179 gchar * str = g_strdup_printf (_("Set %s preferences as default preferences ?"), _(pstring[oid -> b]));
5180 project * this_proj = get_project_by_id(oid -> a);
5181 if (ask_yes_no(_("Set model preferences as default ?"), str, GTK_MESSAGE_QUESTION, this_proj -> modelgl -> win))
5182 {
5183 g_free (str);
5184 image * img = this_proj -> modelgl -> anim -> last -> img;
5185 switch (oid -> b)
5186 {
5187 case 0:
5188 // OpenGL preferences, style and color mpas not included : rendering only
5189 default_opengl[3] = img -> quality;
5190 default_opengl[4] = img -> ray_tracing;
5191 duplicate_material (& default_material, & img -> m_terial);
5192 default_lightning.lights = img -> l_ghtning.lights;
5193 default_lightning.spot = copy_light_sources (img -> l_ghtning.lights, img -> l_ghtning.lights, img -> l_ghtning.spot);
5194 duplicate_fog (& default_fog, & img -> f_g);
5195 break;
5196 case 1:
5197 // Box
5198 duplicate_box_data (& default_box, img -> abc);
5199 break;
5200 case 2:
5201 // Axis
5202 duplicate_axis_data (& default_axis, img -> xyz);
5203 break;
5204 case 3:
5205 // Background
5206 duplicate_background_data (& default_background, img -> back);
5207 break;
5208 case 4:
5209 // Representation
5210 default_rep.rep = img -> rep;
5211 default_rep.zoom = img -> zoom;
5212 default_rep.gnear = img -> gnear;
5213 int i;
5214 for (i=0; i<2; i++)
5215 {
5216 default_rep.c_angle[i] = img -> c_angle[i];
5217 default_rep.c_shift[i] = img -> c_shift[i];
5218 }
5219 break;
5220 }
5221 str = g_strdup_printf (_("Do you want to save <b>atomes</b> preferences in:\n\n\t%s\n\nIf found this file is processed at every <b>atomes</b> startup.\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\tSave file ?"), ATOMES_CONFIG);
5222 if (ask_yes_no(_("Save atomes preferences to file ?"), str, GTK_MESSAGE_QUESTION, this_proj -> modelgl -> win))
5223 {
5224 if (! save_preferences_to_xml_file ())
5225 {
5226 show_error ((pref_error) ? pref_error : _("Error while trying to save preferences to file"), 0, atomes_main_window);
5227 g_free (pref_error);
5228 pref_error = NULL;
5229 }
5230 }
5231 g_free (str);
5232 }
5233 else
5234 {
5235 g_free (str);
5236 }
5237}
